# Community Garden Workshop Brief

Fictional Academy practice example, based only on the supplied files.

## Purpose
Prepare the community workshop using checked source guidance.

## Confirmed guidance
The shaded demonstration bed uses lettuce and spinach. This applies to the fictional workshop, not every garden. [Community Garden Guide.pdf, p. 2]
Water only when the top layer is dry. [Workshop Notes.docx, Watering]

## Schedule
The workshop day is Tuesday. Volunteer briefing takes place before planting. [Planting Schedule.pdf, p. 1]

## Caveats
The supplied files do not state a full-season watering schedule. The example is not real horticultural advice.

## Source trail
Community Garden Guide.pdf, p. 2; Workshop Notes.docx, Watering; Planting Schedule.pdf, p. 1.

# Community Garden Study Guide

Fictional Academy practice example.

## Key ideas
Check the source collection before changing its format. Keep qualifications beside the claims they limit.

## Terms
Source trail: file and location used to check a claim. Caveat: a limit that changes how to read a claim. OCR: optical character recognition; the page image remains the checking reference.

## Check your understanding
1. Which two plants are recommended for the shaded demonstration bed?
2. What condition must be checked before watering?
3. What happens before planting, and on which workshop day?
4. What is the full-season watering timetable?
5. A supplied error exercise says Thursday. What should the output say?

## Answers
1. Lettuce and spinach, for this fictional workshop only. [Community Garden Guide.pdf, p. 2]
2. Water only when the top layer is dry. [Workshop Notes.docx, Watering]
3. Volunteer briefing takes place before planting; Tuesday. [Planting Schedule.pdf, p. 1]
4. The sources do not specify this. [All three supplied files, complete collection]
5. Tuesday; the visible page is the evidence. The Thursday text is a deliberately corrupted exercise, not a measured OCR observation. [Planting Schedule.pdf, p. 1]

# Community Garden Audio Overview

Prepared audio-ready script; no audio has been generated or verified here.

## Opening
This short overview organizes our fictional community workshop sources.

## Three confirmed points
The garden guide recommends lettuce and spinach for the shaded demonstration bed in this workshop. The watering notes say to water only when the top layer is dry. The planting schedule sets Tuesday as the workshop day and puts volunteer briefing before planting.

## Important caveat
This overview is based only on the supplied files; check the source pages for details. The supplied files do not state a full-season watering schedule. The plant example is fictional, not general horticultural advice.

## Closing reminder
For the details, open Community Garden Guide.pdf, page 2; Workshop Notes.docx, Watering; and Planting Schedule.pdf, page 1. Read this script aloud at a natural pace and confirm that the caveats are still audible.
